url.description: If set, indicates this is a link to the external web page at this URL.

relativeLink.description: If set, indicates this is a link to a slide in this presentation, addressed by its position.

pageObjectId.description: If set, indicates this is a link to the specific page in this presentation with this ID.

slideIndex.description: If set, indicates this is a link to the slide at this zero-based index in the presentation.
